questions.HRS1_PERIOPERATIVE: People before, during or after surgery, procedures or anesthesia, and their use of dietary supplements or nutritional products (use, effect, harm).
questions.HRS2_KIDNEY_DISEASE: People with kidney disease, kidney failure or on dialysis, and their use of dietary supplements or nutritional products (use, effect, harm).
questions.HRS3_PREGNANCY: Pregnant or breastfeeding people, or fetal exposure, and dietary supplements or nutritional products (use, effect, harm).
questions.HRS4_LIVER_DISEASE: People with liver disease or liver failure using supplements, or liver toxicity caused by dietary supplements or nutritional products.
questions.HRS5_ANTICOAGULATION: People on anticoagulant or antiplatelet drugs, or at bleeding risk, and dietary supplements or nutritional products (use, effect, harm).

axis_tests.age_group: The abstract states the participants' age, age range or age group (e.g. older adults, children, mean age).
axis_tests.concomitant_medication: The abstract names a drug the participants were taking besides the supplement, or a drug-supplement combination.
axis_tests.dose_range: The abstract states how much of the supplement was given or taken (amount with a unit, e.g. 500 mg/day).
axis_tests.sex: The abstract reports participants' sex, a sex breakdown, or a single-sex population.
axis_tests.underlying_condition: The abstract names a disease or clinical condition of the participants other than the situation itself, or describes the situation-defining disease in a specific form.
